title: WhatsApp preps travel eSIM discovery, installation, and management tools (Update: Official)
summary: WhatsApp could soon be your one-stop shop for all things eSIM.
body: TL;DR WhatsApp appears to be developing a system for eSIM discovery, purchase, installation, and management. Users would be able to search for eSIMs based on specific travel destinations. Automated tools could wait to activate the eSIM until you arrive where you’re headed. Update, November 26, 2026 (2:11 PM ET): WhatsApp has just confirmed its travel eSIM feature. Service will be available through Jio, Smart Axiata, Smart Communications, Verizon, and other partners. Original article, November 25, 2026 (4:37 PM ET): WhatsApp just got a big upgrade with the announcement of support for scheduling messages , and now we’re already getting an early look at what could be coming next, as we uncover evidence for what looks like a new travel eSIM feature.
